title: Passive chronology with an unreadable record: rejected flagship, retained research

opportunity.title: Passive chronology with an unreadable record: rejected flagship, retained research
opportunity.beneficiary: Potential operators of reusable industrial handling fixtures, not observed buyers
opportunity.valuable_outcome: Recover the exact order of four distinct once-only mechanical events from a final passive readout despite one known erased bit, with correct surviving bits
uncertainty: No flagship qualifies: discovery origin was agent-generated but substantive novelty failed
One XOR bit is an abstract storage resource, not one physical component
No physical transducer, fabricated device, field reliability or customer acceptance
Economic outputs are conditional scenarios with assumed demand and qualification probability
Operational Alpha was not measured and identical-information library ties technical transfer

transformation_witness.original_purpose: Full four-event history after one known erasure
transformation_witness.binding_restriction: Adjacent swaps differ at one pairwise bit; erasing that bit creates ambiguity
transformation_witness.proposed_change: Append standard XOR parity to the complete pairwise order code
preserved_obligations: All24 histories and all eraseable positions remain
Events occur exactly once; surviving bits are correct
Do not substitute two-event precedence for full chronology
Do not equate abstract bits with complete physical resources
transformation_witness.acceptance: Abstract parity recovery168/168; original physical delivery unqualified; novelty rejected
transformation_witness.falsifier: Any undecodable allowed history, conventional equal-information parity, uncounted physical resources, or task substitution

opportunity.next_experiment: First specify a materially useful physical function not attainable by the identified controls at a matched full-resource budget; do not fabricate a familiar latch merely to claim discovery.
